claims: H-E-B stores will be closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
All H-E-B locations will close on April 5, 2026.
H-E-B will have no curbside pickup services available on April 5, 2026.
H-E-B will have no home delivery services available on April 5, 2026.
H-E-B normal business hours will resume on Monday, April 6, 2026.
Central Market will be closed on April 5, 2026.
